stories.title: U.S.–Iran talks are put on hold as fighting escalates in Lebanon
stories.summary: Peace talks between the U.S. and Iran scheduled to take place Friday were postponed due to continued Israeli attacks in Lebanon.

stories.title: The view from Beirut hours into latest ceasefire
stories.summary: Just hours into the ceasefire, we check on Lebanon to see if this delicate agreement is actually holding.

stories.title: Scottish 'Tartan Army' drinks Boston dry
stories.summary: Scottish soccer fans have taken over Boston to watch the World Cup. The Tartan Army, as they are called, brought their Scottish traditions with them: Kilts, bagpipes and lots of drinking.

stories.title: Cape Verde's goalie, the overnight sensation
stories.summary: On any given week, there could be a main character that the internet is obsessed with. Right now, it's the Cape Verde team's goal keeper – Josimar Jose Evora Dias – better known as Vozinha.

stories.title: Chicago celebrates Obama Presidential Center opening, but community concerns persist
stories.summary: Some supporters view the Obama Presidential Center as a welcomed investment in a historically underserved area, while long-time residents and community members worry it may accelerate gentrification.

stories.title: A new study rewrites the history of the plague
stories.summary: A new study looks at one of the most prolific pathogens in human history — the plague.
